<!-- pr-reviewer: f737edf766a2ff843584599acbbbe9d40146ea11 -->
Ready for the maintainer to merge. Docs-only; no code change, no build, no gates run here (per the PR body and review policy).

What looks good:
- The three new lines in `.claude/skills/camcraft-mcp/SKILL.md` match the source at `f737edf76` exactly:
  - `--ui call <tool> <json>` goes through the same answer path as the `--mcp-port` door: both inboxes (`state.mcp` and `state.ui_link`) are answered by `answer_request` in `crates/ui/src/mcp_host.rs`, one function, with the window's History and the same `LiveGate` - "through the same History and live gate" holds.
  - Exit 3 for no running window, no headless fallback: `LinkError::NoWindow` maps to 3 (`crates/app/src/mcp/link_client.rs`, `exit_code`), and the usage text says it never falls back.
  - Exit 2 for multiple windows without selection, nothing runs: `LinkError::Choose` maps to 2 and the error message says "nothing ran". The doc deliberately does not promise selection of the first window (the issue text said that; the PR is right to refuse that).
  - `--window <pid|project>` syntax matches the usage line and the parser (`--window` must come right after `--ui`, before the verb).
- The "Process change: yes" line is present, the diff touches one process file, `.claude/PROCESS_VERSION` is unchanged, `Changelog: none`, `Effort: low`, and the body ends with `Fixes #3864`. All process rules pass.

Results merged with main (267ee5096bde18de7c82f18bc93c041a773baa97, this head is a single commit on top):
- Trial merge: clean, "Already up to date" - no conflict; `gh pr view --json mergeable` says MERGEABLE.
- Build / tests / clippy / gates: not run - docs-only PR; no code in the diff. The author's quick-plan dry run selected zero steps ("nothing in crates/ changed"), which is consistent.
- Windows-only readings or ui re-runs: none owed (no `cfg(windows)` or per-OS lines in the diff).

No blockers, no requested changes. No heavy lane or light lane owed: the diff reaches no lane (docs only) and no test suites were touched.

Notes (non-blocking):
- The body ends with `Closes #3864` and then `Fixes #3864` on the next line; one of the two would do, but both are harmless.
- The body names `crates/app/src/cli_ui.rs:16-42` and `:58-87` as help/parser sources; the ranges are a little wide (the help text is 14-40, the parser 52-90) but the references are correct.
- The linked issue #3864 text says the call goes to "the first running window"; the PR correctly does not repeat that, and the body says why. Worth keeping in that issue's thread.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
